title: q-enriched-transfinite-cellular-sheaf
description: A quantale-enriched cellular sheaf laid over a transfinite cell complex - per-cell stalks in Q-Cat_cwl with restriction Q-functors along face incidences, generated by extending the finite-base Q-enriched sheaf framework to the omega_1-cofinal cellular base and determined by its restrictions to finite sub-complexes.

stalks.description: assigns to each cell sigma a stalk F(sigma) in Q-Cat_cwl (complete-and-weakly-cocomplete Q-categories)

restrictions.description: assigns to each face incidence sigma < tau (dim sigma + 1 = dim tau) a Q-functor f_sigma^tau : F(sigma) -> F(tau)

finite-restriction-coherence.description: for every finite sub-complex X|_F the restriction F|_{X|_F} is a finite-CW Q-enriched cellular sheaf; equivalently F = colim over finite sub-complexes of its restrictions

transfinite-fuzziness.description: the degree-k transfinite Curry fuzziness q_k^transfin(X,F) = meet over finite sub-complexes of q_k(X|_F, F|_{X|_F}), well-defined since Q has all countable meets; non-degeneracy (q_k^transfin > bottom) is the key concrete check
